dict.Câte luni trec între verificări scrie fi: How many months pass between checks is set by the authorised company that checks them; change the 12 in N2 if it is different.
dict.Pe planul de evacuare: Docs → Inserare →: On the evacuation plan: Docs → Insert → ☺ Icons → Workplace safety (the extinguisher) and Fire and emergency.
dict.Pentru firme, magazine, școli și asociaț: For companies, shops, schools and residents' associations: each fire extinguisher with its serial number, type, location, year of manufacture and the date of the last check; you get the next check (after the number of months you set, usually 12), the days left and the status: overdue or faulty (in red), within 30 days (in yellow), up to date (in green), not checked or out of service; on the right how many need checking and the nearest check, with the extinguisher's location.
dict.Un stingător descărcat, cu sigiliul rupt: An extinguisher that is discharged, has a broken seal or a pressure needle outside the green zone: Pressure and seal = No (shows Faulty).
